descriptions.total_core_hours: Total CPU core-hours of requested compute (executor_count x cores x elapsed / 3600). Uses per-job profile cores from K8s manifest, not the global executor.cores config value
descriptions.compute_efficiency_gb_per_core_hour: GB processed per core-hour of requested compute (higher is better)
descriptions.total_data_processed_gb: Sum of input data across all pipeline stages in GB
descriptions.pipeline_throughput_gb_per_second: Total data / wall-clock time in GB/s (higher is better)
descriptions.total_elapsed_seconds: Wall-clock seconds from pipeline start to final stage completion
descriptions.composite_qph: Queries per Hour -- median of in-stream rounds or single benchmark (higher is better)
descriptions.composite_qph_rounds: Continuous. In-stream benchmark rounds whose median is composite_qph (rounds with a QpH); 0 means composite_qph is the single post-stream benchmark. Runs with different counts are not like-for-like
descriptions.composite_qph_basis: Continuous. Whether composite_qph blends in-stream rounds that executed different query sets (blended), and the rounds per executed query set id (sets); 'not_recorded' for rounds that did not record their executed set
descriptions.composite_qph_by_set: Continuous. Median in-stream QpH per executed query set id
descriptions.data_freshness_seconds: Primary freshness score. Worst-case gold table staleness during the streaming window in seconds (lower is better)
descriptions.sustained_throughput_rps: Rows bronze ingested inside the measurement window per second of the window that data was arriving (arrival_seconds), higher is better. Rows ingested before the window opened are not counted. When intake_limit is trickle_rate this is the configured offered load, not a capacity
descriptions.window_seconds: Length of the measurement window: from the moment every stream's driver was running, run_duration seconds
descriptions.arrival_seconds: Seconds of the window data was still arriving at bronze: the whole window while corpus was left, else until one bronze trigger after its last write inside the window
descriptions.window_arrival_fraction: arrival_seconds / window_seconds. Below 1 the corpus ran out inside the window; the window after that measured an idle pipeline
descriptions.pre_window_rows: Rows bronze ingested before the window opened (a stream that started while another waited to submit). Not part of any window score
descriptions.ingest_ratio: Bronze rows ingested by the window's end / rows the trickle had released to bronze by then (released_rows: max_files_per_trigger files per bronze trigger since bronze's first write, at the corpus's mean rows per file, capped at the corpus). 1.0 = bronze kept up with what arrived. Falls back to corpus_ingest_ratio when released_rows is unknown
descriptions.corpus_ingest_ratio: Bronze rows ingested by the window's end / datagen rows produced: the share of the whole corpus taken. Below 1 on a default run, whose trickle is sized to outlast the window
descriptions.released_rows: Rows the trickle had made available to bronze by the window's end (ingest_ratio's denominator); null when the corpus file count or window is unknown
descriptions.stage_latency_profile: Average micro-batch processing time per stage {bronze_ms, silver_ms, gold_ms} in ms
descriptions.pipeline_saturated: True when ingest_ratio < 0.95: bronze fell behind the rows the trickle released. False when intake_limit is trickle_rate: the configured trickle, not the pipeline, bounded intake
descriptions.intake_limit: What bounded intake when ingest_ratio < 0.95: bronze_capacity (bronze busy for most of the window; sustained_throughput_rps is its capacity), trickle_rate (bronze ran a micro-batch on nearly every trigger, each inside the trigger, with corpus left: the configured max_files_per_trigger per trigger bounded intake and the pipeline kept pace), below_bronze_capacity (bronze had idle time without that pattern: a late start or a stall), none (kept up: ingest_ratio >= 0.95). Whether the trickle held intake (BOUNDED BY trickle: ingested / offered rows >= 0.99 and lag within one trigger) is experiment.limits.trickle_bound
descriptions.corpus_drain_seconds: When intake_limit is trickle_rate: seconds the trickle needs to ingest the whole corpus at the rate it held (datagen rows / sustained_throughput_rps); a window this long drains it
descriptions.bronze_busy_fraction: Share of the window bronze spent inside micro-batches (batches x mean batch time / window)
descriptions.time_to_detect_seconds: AML continuous. Median seconds from the newest bronze ingest of an alert's related transactions to the commit of the rule's alerts on the tick that first raised it (lower is better)
descriptions.time_to_detect_p95_seconds: AML continuous. 95th percentile of time_to_detect (histogram bin upper edge, 10 s bins)
descriptions.time_to_detect_max_seconds: AML continuous. Longest time to detect of any newly raised alert
descriptions.time_to_detect_alerts: AML continuous. Newly raised alerts the time to detect is measured over
descriptions.time_to_detect_late_alerts: AML continuous. Measured alerts whose related transactions were all in silver before the previous detection pass (re-raised after a rule error, or evidence outside related_txn_ids); included in the percentiles
descriptions.time_to_detect_unmeasured_cycles: AML continuous. Gold cycles that logged no time-to-detect line; their alerts are measured on the next cycle, late by one cycle
descriptions.corpus_drained: True when every datagen row reached bronze and silver committed all of them before the window ended: freshness covers only gold cycles that saw new data, and arrival_seconds stops at bronze's last write
descriptions.total_rows_processed: Rows taken in across all streaming stages inside the measurement window (gold re-reads of silver included)
descriptions.total_s3_objects: Total S3 objects across bronze/silver/gold buckets at end of run. Growth rate vs retention capacity is the key signal -- if this grows unbounded, metadata ops degrade
descriptions.query_time_event_age_seconds: Diagnostic, not freshness. Median age of the newest event date in gold at benchmark query time (query time minus MAX(interaction_date), day resolution). It tracks where the corpus's event timestamps sit, not how stale gold is; data_freshness_seconds is the freshness score. Replaces query_time_freshness_seconds, which carried this figure under a freshness name
descriptions.in_stream_composite_qph: Median QpH from in-stream benchmark rounds
descriptions.benchmark_rounds_count: Number of in-stream benchmark rounds executed
descriptions.qph_degradation_pct: QpH degradation from first-half to second-half of sustained run (positive = slower, negative = faster)
descriptions.qph_degradation_withheld: Continuous. Why qph_degradation_pct is not recorded though the run has four or more rounds: the rounds ran different query sets, so the two halves time different work
descriptions.time_to_value_seconds: Wall-clock seconds from first input to queryable gold (lower is better)
descriptions.scale_ratio: Actual data volume / expected volume for the scale factor (1.0 = complete)
descriptions.time_to_value_datagen_excluded_seconds: Multi-cycle batch: seconds of the cycles' datagen inside the time-to-value span, left out of time_to_value_seconds
descriptions.cycle_progression: Per-cycle elapsed time, QpH, and table health for multi-cycle batch runs
descriptions.maintenance_elapsed_seconds: Total seconds spent on expire_snapshots + remove_orphan_files + compaction
descriptions.maintenance_stopped: True when pre-benchmark maintenance stopped early (a statement timed out or the 30 min cap hit); a statement may still have been running, so post_compaction_qph is not a clean measurement and maintenance_value_pct is null
descriptions.maintenance_live_streams: True when stream apps were present (or could not be read) during pre-benchmark maintenance; the post-maintenance QpH was measured with writers live and is not gated
descriptions.maintenance_live_streams_reason: Which stream apps were present, and any read errors
descriptions.maintenance_pct_of_pipeline: Maintenance time as percentage of total pipeline time
descriptions.pre_compaction_file_count: Iceberg data files before rewrite_data_files / OPTIMIZE
descriptions.post_compaction_file_count: Iceberg data files after rewrite_data_files / OPTIMIZE
descriptions.compaction_ratio: pre/post file count ratio (higher = more compaction benefit)
descriptions.snapshots_expired: Number of snapshots removed by expire_snapshots
descriptions.orphan_files_removed: Number of orphan files cleaned up by remove_orphan_files
descriptions.storage_reclaimed_mb: MB of storage freed by maintenance operations
descriptions.pre_compaction_qph: QpH measured before maintenance (on uncompacted data)
descriptions.post_compaction_qph: QpH measured after maintenance (on compacted data) -- the primary QpH score
descriptions.maintenance_value_pct: QpH change from maintenance over the queries that succeeded in both runs: (post - pre) / pre * 100; null when not measurable or within the within-round spread
descriptions.maintenance_value_reason: Why maintenance_value_pct is null: not measurable, one sample per query, or within noise
descriptions.benchmark_samples_per_query: Timed samples per query in the scored benchmark round (QpH uses the per-query median; 1 means no measured spread)
descriptions.qph_spread: QpH of the slowest and fastest round the per-query samples allow, and their relative range
descriptions.maintenance_paired_queries: Queries that succeeded before and after maintenance (the base of maintenance_value_pct)
descriptions.maintenance_settle_seconds: Seconds from maintenance end until a storage-bound probe query was stable, before the post-maintenance round; not counted in time_to_value
descriptions.maintenance_settled: True when the probe settled within the cap; false means the post round ran on unsettled storage and maintenance_value_pct is null
descriptions.maintenance_settle_capped: True when the settle wait reached benchmark.maintenance_settle.max_seconds
descriptions.maintenance_settle_verified: False when there was no pre-maintenance probe time (scale >= 50): the probes agreed with each other, which a slow plateau also does
